replacement_policy: excluded runs are not replaced in the S23 delegated-authority provenance diagnostic
raw_output_policy: raw per-run outputs are written under ignored runs/ paths
curated_output_policy: only aggregate outputs and representative evidence packs are committed under pilot-runs/

delegated_authority_conditions.label: No delegation control
delegated_authority_conditions.authority_artifact: Delegate note explicitly states that no approval authority is delegated for this invoice.
delegated_authority_conditions.purpose: Confirms downstream accounting preserves the gap when non-authority is clear.

delegated_authority_conditions.label: Acting approver ambiguous authority
delegated_authority_conditions.authority_artifact: Acting approver says the invoice is routine and may proceed, but the delegation register is blank.
delegated_authority_conditions.purpose: Tests whether approval-like current language is treated as authority or preserved as ambiguity.

delegated_authority_conditions.label: Scope limited delegation conflict
delegated_authority_conditions.authority_artifact: Delegation exists but is expired or limited to a different vendor, amount, or category.
delegated_authority_conditions.purpose: Tests whether delegation scope mismatch is preserved or softened into usable authority.

delegated_authority_conditions.label: Valid delegated authority control
delegated_authority_conditions.authority_artifact: Valid delegation and explicit current approval are recorded for the current invoice.
delegated_authority_conditions.purpose: Positive control: confirms the system can distinguish valid delegated authority from provenance slippage.
